shared_elements: upright figures rendered in shallow relief
horizontal divisions separating zones of the surface
raised rectangular panel set off from surrounding stone
justification: Both are weathered pale limestone surfaces with shallow relief organised into horizontally divided zones, and each has small upright figures standing free against a plainer ground, which is the most concrete correspondence. But A is dominated by a large blank recessed panel with only two eroded, indistinct vertical figures near the base, whereas B is densely populated with clearly legible animals, birds and a patterned band across a shaped pillar, so the imagery, density and carving quality differ fundamentally.
